properties.description: The driver that reads a git range as a design change: changed files, to registered artifacts by location, to reconcile_artifacts' propagation seeds, to propagate_from's radius. Unmapped files first and counted; --fail-on-unmapped is the opt-in exit code; the export itself is set aside as the record. Same stdio client and hash helper as reflow2_check.py.
